name: Camp Wonderland
description_short: The Salvation Army's Massachusetts summer camp, on 110 acres on Lake Massapoag in Sharon, running since 1924. Activities include swimming lessons, scouting, arts and crafts, music and sports, in a Christian setting.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on Lake Massapoag; activities include learning to swim.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Camp and Summer Programs - Salvation Army Fall River Corps

warnings: This is a general Salvation Army Fall River Corps page about summer programs, not Camp Wonderland's own site. It gives no dates, prices or ages for any season.
The address (290 Bedford Street, Fall River, MA 02722) and the 1-800-SAL-ARMY number in the footer belong to the Fall River Corps, not the camp, so they were not recorded as camp contact details.
The ACA accreditation comes from a blanket statement that 'All of our camps are ACA accredited', not a claim made about Camp Wonderland specifically.
The page mentions 'hundreds of day camps'. It's unclear whether the Fall River Corps runs a separate local day program.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
unknowns: Whether Camp Wonderland is overnight (residential) or day camp, or both
Financial aid / camperships (the page mentions serving low-income families and asks for donations, but doesn't describe an aid process)
